p4.text: In different countries, people have parties on special days __(1)__ very different ways. In China, the New Year is __(2)__ for beautiful red __(3)__ and king dances. parts.text: Last July, I went to a summer camp called "Wild Adventures" with my second brother Max. The camp was in the countryside, next to a big lake. We stayed for 14 days. There were 60 children in the camp, from 8 to 12 years old. Our teacher, Aisha, was really fun and always had good ideas for things to do. Every morning we had a different thing to do: swimming in the lake, climbing, painting, or cooking around the fire. My favourite was sailing. Max’s favourite was making music with other children around the fire at night. On the last day, we had a school show. I sang a song with my new friends Petra and Juno. Max did something funny and made a key disappear. Everyone clapped loudly. We went home with lots of stories and a small photo book. I want to go back next year!

p6.text: New Year’s Eve is my favourite party of the year. My family always stays __(0)__ home. My dad cooks a special dinner __(1)__ my mum paints the living room with balloons.
